_evidence: 0x00531648 runs [0x8274ad] entries of one of the two static 7-entry callback tables (12-byte entries {fn0, fn1, x}: 0x8274b1 when byte [0x7ad869] != 0, else 0x827505; the code pointers are image constants such as 0x531721/0x53177b/0x531741/0x531743, so the tables are NOT varied: fuzz:i32 had overwritten their first dwords). The count is drawn 0..7: 0x5316b8 bounds its walk of the same tables by 7 ('cmp ecx,7; jb'). [0x7ad869] is 0 or 0xff (the only values stored by 0x530c2d/0x52fe95/0x53106d). The callbacks read [0x7ad87c] (cmp 0: stc/clc and 'mov byte [ebx+0x24],0'), [0x7ad86c] = device record - 1 (stored as [ebx]-1 for a nonzero record type 1..2 and used as (x+1)*0x3c + 0x827160 over the 3 records that 0x531859 walks, so 0 or 1) and test bits 4/8 of dword +8 of records 1 and 2 (0x8271a4, 0x8271e0). The callbacks write the render-state record ebx (+0..+0x27), which the spec supplies.
